items.briefing:
Cyber ransoms remain a pressing concern for Australian organisations, with security expert Troy Hunt's latest update highlighting the ongoing threat ransomware poses to businesses of all sizes. Separately, a new report suggests AI tools are quietly adding to the workload of Australian employees rather than reducing it — a reminder that AI adoption should be carefully managed to avoid unintended consequences.

On the technical side, a newly identified Linux botnet called Evooo1Bot is expanding beyond typical denial-of-service attacks, meaning internet-connected devices and servers could be at greater risk. **Practical tip:** Ensure all internet-facing devices and servers are running the latest software updates to reduce exposure to emerging botnet threats.

featured.title: Fujitsu & DigiCert team up on certificate management
featured.quote: Shorter SSL certificate lifespans require Australian businesses to urgently automate renewal processes.
